Administering KoldFusion Server

Logging Settings

The General Error Logging page says where KoldFusion writes its logs, who the administrator is and what extra information gets logged.

Go there: Open the Logging Settings page (or inside the frameset)

Setting Default What it does
Administrator E-Mail (blank) When set, every error page ends with a request to tell the site administrator, and a mailto: link to this address.
Log Directory kfroot/log Where every log file is written. The directory must already exist; Browse Server... helps you pick one. The change applies right away.
Log Slow Pages off, 30 seconds Writes a Warning to server.log for every page that takes longer than the given number of seconds.
System Logging: Use UNIX syslog off Also sends every log entry to the UNIX syslog (facility daemon), with Error, Warning or Information priority.

What goes where

File Contains
application.log Every CFML error a visitor saw, with the template, line and browser
server.log Server events: restarts, unresponsive requests, slow pages
mail.log Mail that could not be delivered
mailsent.log Every message sent, when "Log all email messages" is on (Mail Logging)
schedule.log Scheduled task runs (Scheduler Settings)
access.log Every HTTP request, web server style

Except for access.log, which uses the common web-server format, each line has the quoted, comma-separated layout of the 4.x logs: "Severity","ThreadID","Date","Time","Details". The files load straight into Excel.

Tips

  • Change the Log Directory only to a directory that the server process can write to. If it cannot, log entries are silently lost.
  • Set Log Slow Pages to 10 seconds or so on a production server, and check server.log on Monday mornings.
